title: The ring detects isomorphisms between continuous exact derived functors
statement: For a commutative ring R, let F,G : D(R) → T be triangulated functors to a triangulated category, preserving coproducts indexed in the module universe. Let τ : F → G commute with integer shifts. If τ at R[0] is invertible then τ is invertible. Here D(R) is [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: Reuse the proved source theorem. Naturality, shift compatibility and exactness close the invertible components under shifts, retracts, triangles and coproducts. Free modules and their projective retracts belong to this class. The telescope of bounded stupid truncations of a projective resolution gives every single module. The telescope of the bounded double truncations of an arbitrary complex gives every derived object. Essential surjectivity of localization transfers the conclusion to all objects. This is the same generator argument as Stacks Tag 09PB, already implemented in the cited source.
